subject: Television & Streaming
title: Peak TV and Content Overload
description: A quick win: understand Peak TV and Content Overload.

hook.text: In 2022, over 600 scripted TV shows aired in the United States alone. Nobody could watch them all.

buildup.text: Every streaming platform needed exclusive content to justify its subscription. Studios greenlit everything.

discovery.text: FX chairman John Landgraf coined the term Peak TV.

twist.text: Great shows got canceled because nobody found them. Discovery became harder as libraries grew larger.

climax.text: Peak TV meant more choices but less cultural impact. When everything is available, nothing feels essential.

punchline.text: Too much good TV became its own kind of problem.

quiz.question: What does 'Peak TV' describe?
options: An oversaturation of scripted television content
The highest-rated show of all time
